newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ASEAN business urges EU to defer new tariff scheme.
newsitem.headline: ASEAN business urges EU to defer new tariff scheme.

text.p: The Asean Chambers of Commerce and Industry (Asean-CCI) has urged the European Union to defer the implementation of a new tariff scheme for agricultural products which is to take effect next year, the chamber's executive committee chairman Jose Concepcion said on Monday.
"Asean-CCI expresses its strong concern over the new EU GSP for agricultural products to be effective on January 1, 1997," Concepcion said in a statement.
The European Union's new generalised system of preferences (GSP) will exclude major food products.

"Asean-CCI urges the EU to defer the implementation of the scheme and to consider the possibility of setting up appropriate measures to minimise the adverse impact on agricultural sector in the Asean region," he added.
Asean groups the Philippines, Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Brunei, and Vietnam.
